messages:
sara: Starting coordinated regional rollout for v2.3.1. Sequence: US canary -> EU canary (delayed window) -> APAC drip. Change windows: US 02:00-04:00 UTC, EU 03:00-05:00 UTC, APAC 12:00-14:00 UTC. Fallback rule: pin region to v2.3.0 on quality/latency regressions.

mike: Acknowledged. What are warm-pool numbers?

ops-oncall: Warm-pool snapshot — US: 160G reserved (target 120G), EU: 78G (target 100G), APAC: 58G (target 80G). APAC under by ~22G.

leo: Recommend APAC burst-autoscale for initial drip + q8 fallback model (v2.3.1-q8) if memory pressure > 92%.

anita: Suggest delaying EU canary 10m to avoid interfering with scheduled EU batch at 03:05 UTC.

sara: Delay EU canary 10m. US canary go live now. deploy-bot, start US canary.

deploy-bot: Starting US canary -> slices: us-west1,us-east1 traffic=10%
```
deploy-bot: deploy_id=deploy-3123456789-us state=started pinned_model=v2.3.1 traffic_split=10%
```

mike: US canary warm. Observability: p95=122ms, err_rate=0.6%, GPU_reserve=88%. Throughput steady.

ops-oncall: Rollback triggers: sustained err_rate >3% over 5m OR p95>200ms OR GPU_reserve>95% >10m.

leo: Seeing a small quality dip for long-context summarization (~4.5% quality drop). Not blocking but noted.

anita: Can we run a synthetic long-context smoke (200 samples) against canary before EU starts?

mike: Kicking off synthetic run now — ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Synthetic eval started: 200 samples queued
```
deploy-bot: eval_id=eval-3123456789-longcontext samples=200
```

deploy-bot: Synthetic eval done: quality_drop=4.9% -> below hold threshold (6%).

leo: Good. EU canary in 5m (we still keep 10m delay originally). Anita prep EU pin/cutover rollback notes.

anita: EU pin rule: if any of [err_rate>2% sustained, p95>220ms, quality_drop>6%] then pin EU to v2.3.0 and open #inc-rollback-eu. Release notes updated with known long-context regression and mitigation steps.

sara: EU canary go. deploy-bot start EU slices at 8% traffic.

deploy-bot: Starting EU canary -> slices: eu-west1,eu-central1 traffic=8% pinned_model=v2.3.1
```
deploy-bot: deploy_id=deploy-3123456789-eu state=started traffic_split=8%
```

mike: EU warmup: p95=134ms, err_rate=0.45%, GPU_reserve=81%. Running smoke set now.

anita: Smoke set finished: 150 samples, quality_drop=2.1%, err_rate_avg=0.5%. EU looks healthy.

sara: APAC drip: hold until ops confirms warm-pool bump or enables burst. Ops?

ops-oncall: Enabling burst autoscale for 30m starting +2m. That should cover initial drip.

mike: Recommend drip cadence: start 2% -> +2% every 10m, monitor GPU_reserve and p95.

leo: Add routing fallback: route APAC to v2.3.1-q8 if GPU_reserve>92% or p95>250ms.

deploy-bot: APAC burst enabled. Starting drip: ap-southeast1,ap-northeast1 initial=2% next=+2%/10m
```
deploy-bot: deploy_id=deploy-3123456789-apac state=started initial_traffic=2% plan:+2%/10m
```

mike: APAC step1: p95=178ms, err_rate=0.9%, GPU_reserve=79%. Proceed to 4% in 10m.

anita: Preparing rollback PR and customer comms draft in case fallback/pinning needed.

sara: Summary: US canary passed; small long-context regression but within threshold. EU canary healthy. APAC drip under burst, slow ramp. Rollback triggers: err_rate>3% sustained, p95>220ms, quality_drop>6% -> pin region to v2.3.0 and open incident. If no triggers, full traffic ramp in US in 90m then EU/APAC follows. Keep monitoring on this thread. :thumbsup:
